original: Recolor your equipped gear. Load into the world first.
translation: 给装备染色，请先进入游戏世界。

original: Socket abyss gears into your equipped gear.
translation: 给已装备物品镶嵌深渊装备。

original: Socket abyss gears into your gear. Load into the world first.
translation: 镶嵌深渊装备，请先进入游戏世界。

original: Keeps your health full. Load into the game world first.
translation: 保持生命值全满，请先进入游戏。

original: Gifting NPCs or feeding animals builds trust faster (20x maxes most in one gift).
translation: 送礼或喂食时更快提升信赖度。

original: Gifting NPCs or feeding animals builds trust faster. Unavailable right now.
translation: 送礼或喂食时更快提升信赖度，当前不可用。

original: Adjusts how much damage you deal.
Adjusts how much damage you take.
Could not dye that - see the log
Load into the world - if this persists, change any equipment piece once so the mod can see your gear.
translation: 请进入游戏；若仍无效，请更换一次装备。

original: None of these pieces can be dyed.
Which part of the item to color. Most gear only uses the first few.
translation: 选择染色部位，多数装备只使用前几个区域。

original: Pick a color family to browse its shades below.
translation: 选择色系并浏览下方色调。

original: Pick a tone, or the first swatch to remove the dye.
translation: 选择色调；首个色块可移除染色。

original: Pick a color to dye it right away.
Mix your own color instead of a preset.
translation: 自定义颜色，不使用预设。

original: Swap the fabric or metal look. 0 keeps it natural.
translation: 调整布料或金属质感，0为自然。

original: How worn the piece looks. 100 is pristine, 0 is battle-scarred.
translation: 调整磨损程度，100崭新，0严重磨损。

original: Dye it with this exact color.
That zone has no dye yet

translation: 编辑该装备的深渊插槽。

original: This piece is no longer equipped.
Opens every socket on this piece (up to 5), then socket gears into them.
translation: 解锁全部插槽（最多5个）并镶嵌装备。

original: Could not unlock - see the log
Removes every abyss gear from this piece, leaving the sockets open.
translation: 移除该物品全部深渊装备并保留插槽。

original: Could not clear - see the log
Unlock sockets above to add abyss gears.
translation: 先解锁插槽再添加装备。

original: Your save is still loading - gear edits apply visually but revert on reload until this clears.
translation: 存档仍在加载；当前修改重载后可能还原。

original: Change or remove this abyss gear.
translation: 更换或移除此深渊装备。

original: Add an abyss gear to this socket.
translation: 向此插槽添加深渊装备。

original: Remove whatever gear is in this socket.
The game's Abyss Gear catalog did not resolve.
translation: 无法读取游戏的深渊装备目录。

original: Find an abyss gear by name.
Could not socket that - see the log
No abyss gear is called that.
Only the first 200 are listed - keep typing to narrow it down.
translation: 仅显示前200项，请继续输入以缩小范围。

original: Speeds up or slows down the game.
Speeds up or slows down the game. Unavailable right now.
translation: 加快或减慢游戏速度，当前不可用。

original: Copy these coordinates to the clipboard.
Load into the world and take a step first.
translation: 请先进入游戏并移动一步。

original: Warp to any location on the map.
Loading - if this persists, load into the world first.
translation: 正在加载；若持续如此，请先进入游戏。

original: Browse and warp to this category's locations.
translation: 浏览并传送到此分类地点。

original: Nothing to warp to in this category.
translation: 此分类没有可传送地点。

original: Editing is locked until your save finishes loading.
translation: 存档加载完成前无法编辑。

original: Change how many you have, or remove it.
Add any item in the game to your inventory.
translation: 向背包添加任意游戏物品。

original: Browse and edit what you're carrying.
translation: 浏览并编辑携带的物品。

original: Sets every storage's slot count to this number.
translation: 将所有仓库格数设为此值。

original: Sets every item's max stack size to this number.
translation: 将全部物品堆叠上限设为此值。

original: Reading your items - if this persists, open your in-game inventory once and come back here.
translation: 正在读取物品；若持续如此，请打开一次游戏背包。

original: Browse and edit what is kept in this storage.
translation: 浏览并编辑此仓库中的物品。

original: Reloads your inventory from the game.
Nothing in this storage right now.
Find an item anywhere in this storage, whatever category it is in.
translation: 在此仓库全部分类中查找物品。

original: Browse and edit items in this category.
translation: 浏览并编辑此分类物品。

original: Nothing in this storage is called that.
translation: 仓库中没有该名称的物品。

original: Sets the %d matching item%s below to this amount.
translation: 将下方%d个匹配物品%s设为此数量。

original: Sets every item in %s to this amount - all %d of them.
translation: 将%s中的全部%d件物品设为此数量。

original: Nothing in this category right now.
Narrow this category down by name.
Nothing in this category is called that.
translation: 此分类中没有该名称的物品。

original: Could not add that item - see the log
Adding is locked until your save finishes loading.
translation: 存档加载完成前无法添加。

original: Set how many, then add it.
The game's item table did not resolve, so there is nothing to add from.
translation: 无法读取游戏物品表，暂时无法添加。

original: Find any item in the game by name, whatever category it is in.
translation: 按名称查找游戏中的任意物品。

original: Add any item from this category.
No item in the game is called that.
Shows your FPS in the corner of the screen.
Saves your settings automatically and restores them next time.
translation: 自动保存设置并在下次恢复。

original: Resets every feature to its default.
translation: 将全部功能恢复默认值。
